sections.heading: Choose the C10 for the years and details you can change.
paragraphs: The black AXI-3408T1 is the current 1967–1972 Chevrolet C10 package, not the earlier AXI00001 vehicle. Its three supplied grilles let the owner represent different years of the second-generation pickup without buying another complete shell. That is a tangible part of the buying case for a Chevrolet fan. The removable two-tone graphics also offer a factory-finished starting point for personalization. I would choose this truck when those details matter and keep the evidence for this updated generation separate from older C10 driving reviews.

sections.heading: Three grilles belong in the box inventory.
paragraphs: The factory list includes the assembled truck, finished body, three interchangeable grilles, SLT2 radio, 350mAh LiPo, USB charger and four AA transmitter cells. Check those physical items when unpacking rather than assuming any C10-branded listing has the same contents. Replacement shells and grille sets can appear in the same search as the vehicle. This review's ASIN identifies the complete black AXI-3408T1. A seller's orange variant or an older generation may look related, but that is a different identity check.

sections.heading: Published motor descriptions conflict, so the review keeps them visible.
paragraphs: The official table still lists an 88T 030 motor, while RC Team's exact AXI-3408 overview calls it an 080 motor. We do not invent a corrected size or use the retailer as proof that the manufacturer's table is a harmless typo. The primary page and exact manual are linked so a buyer can verify the installed label or ask support before buying a replacement. The permanent four-wheel-drive worm-axle layout supports a small crawling recommendation even while that specific motor figure remains disputed.

sections.heading: The SLT2 package is current; old C10 radio advice may not be.
paragraphs: The AXI-3408 package includes a Spektrum SLT2, so an older C10 review may describe the wrong radio generation despite showing a familiar Chevrolet body. Use this model's manual for steering trim, direction and the limiting switch. The RC Team page supplies exact-product retailer context, including the conflicting motor description discussed above; it is not a driving test by RC Car King.

sections.heading: Check the oil-shock description against the older table wording.
paragraphs: The current Axial narrative explicitly describes added oil-filled shocks. Some published table wording still presents legacy coil-over sizing. We identify oil damping as the manufacturer's current feature claim while preserving the spec-table discrepancy. A buyer should follow the AXI-3408 manual and inspect the actual shock before ordering fluid-related rebuild parts. Start with free suspension movement and symmetrical settings. An attractive body customization should not obstruct the tires or force the steering to fight the wheel openings at full articulation.

sections.heading: Bogger tread is a scale choice with a small-wheel limit.
paragraphs: The licensed Interco Super Swamper TSL Boggers and deep-dish slotted wheels make the truck look different from the current 4Runner's Toyo package. That distinction can matter to a scale buyer without being turned into an untested traction score. The official dimensions put the C10 at 213mm long on a 132mm wheelbase. Design home obstacles around that footprint and use dry, predictable surfaces. Large rocks, loose debris and grass can consume far more of a micro truck's usable clearance than a product photo suggests.

sections.heading: Customization should remain easy to reverse.
paragraphs: The polycarbonate shell and supplied year-specific grilles invite personal choices without starting from a clear unpainted body. Try the included options before adding a heavy accessory collection or cutting the shell for oversized tires. Keep removed parts and fasteners labeled by year or position. Access for battery changes and steering inspection remains part of everyday ownership. We have not tested grille retention, shell cracking or long-term graphic wear; those would need a physical test record, so they are not hidden inside a cosmetic durability score.

sections.heading: Use a dated reference while keeping the conflict outside the price promise.
paragraphs: The manufacturer reference recorded on 13 October 2026 is $149.99 for the complete black C10, including the drive battery, charger and transmitter cells. Optional grilles, spare packs, tools and replacement motors have not been priced for this revision. The supplied grille choices are a reason to try the original body before buying more accessories. Resolve the motor-label discrepancy before budgeting a replacement rather than treating an uncertain part as essential completion.

sections.heading: The Toyota alternative makes body preference explicit.
paragraphs: The gray SCX24 Toyota 4Runner AXI-2035T2 is another complete 132mm-wheelbase micro crawler with an ABS hard body and Toyo tires. Its finished SUV presentation differs from the C10's polycarbonate pickup and interchangeable grille set. Choose the Chevrolet for customization within its documented factory body options; choose the Toyota when a hard-shell modern SUV is the main appeal. No measured tire or climbing comparison is claimed. The primary specifications for both are linked so the decision can rest on actual packages.

faqs.question: Which Chevrolet C10 does this review cover?
faqs.answer: The black AXI-3408T1 1967–1972 C10. It is a different generation from the older AXI00001, so older electronics and suspension descriptions should not be applied automatically.

faqs.question: Are the three grilles and power equipment included?
faqs.answer: The documented box contains three interchangeable grilles, a 350mAh 2S LiPo, USB charger, SLT2 radio and four AA transmitter cells with the assembled truck.

faqs.question: Is the motor 030 or 080 size?
faqs.answer: The official table lists an 88T 030 motor, while RC Team’s AXI-3408 page calls it 080. We retain the conflict; check the installed label and exact parts documentation before buying a replacement.

faqs.question: Does this C10 have oil-filled shocks?
faqs.answer: The current-generation Axial narrative describes oil-filled shocks, while other table wording retains coil-over sizing. Consult the AXI-3408 manual and actual component before ordering shock service parts.

faqs.question: What distinguishes it from the SCX24 4Runner?
faqs.answer: The C10 has a polycarbonate pickup body, year-specific grille choices and Interco Bogger tires. The 4Runner uses an ABS SUV body and Toyo tires. Both have a published 132mm wheelbase; no handling winner has been measured here.

faqs.question: Is its editorial score a durability test?
faqs.answer: No. It rates the documented package for a Chevrolet-focused first micro-crawler buyer. RC Car King has not physically tested grille retention, body wear, grip or reliability.
